Written by Safet Begić25 Oct 2026 [...] Celta have a few notable injuries to manage. Forward Borja Iglesias is out with a calf injury, trimming a striking option. Defender Carl Starfelt misses out with a hamstring injury, and forward Jones El-Abdellaoui is unavailable due to a knee injury. Midfielder Miguel Román faces a longer spell on the sidelines after knee surgery, and defender Álvaro Núñez is out with a thigh injury. These absences affect depth across all three lines but the listed XI still shows balance.
